text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle with Inari One, 
Mejiro Ardan senses that the audience's 
perception of her is steadily beginning to 
change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She then commends her beloved rivals, 
Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki, who 
made this fierce battle so unforgettable, 
as they praise each other's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Mejiro Ardan declares her 
goal to challenge Oguri Cap, sharing her 
desire to see if her "current" self can 
hold her own against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—which Oguri 
Cap would be running in—set as her primary 
goal, she took her first steps toward the 
Mainichi Okan as its stepping stone.
